messages:
Maya: Morning thought: if our team LLM had a LinkedIn headline, what would it be? :thinking:
sticker-bot: Suggested headline: 'Conversational Utility Model | Token-efficient Answering | Empathy-first'
Eli: 'Part-time poet, full-time debugger' would get my endorsement
Jordan: we should make it comically corporate: 'Strategic Solutions Architect of Contextual Relevancy' :sweat_smile:
casey: ha! add 'Open to coffee chats and PR reviews'
Maya: also wondering about a mascot — picasso-style robot? or a cozy owl that hoards prompt examples? :owl:
Molly: poll: owl vs robot mascot for swag?
Molly: :owl: Owl (wisdom & late-night help)
Molly: :robot_face: Robot (reliable, slightly judgmental)
Eli: voted :owl: because it reminds me to sleep less and write better prompts
ops-bot: FYI: mascot deployment will not affect runtime or SLOs. Stickers queued in merch backlog.
Jordan: action: Jordan to mockup two sticker drafts. if the owl wins, it gets a tiny pair of glasses and a mug.
Maya: closing note: if the LLM starts leaving Post-its with 'have you tried turning it off and on?', we bundle it as an Easter egg feature.
